LanguageData.ApexMechtech.label: Apex Mechtech
LanguageData.ApexMechtech.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control Apex-tier mechanoids. You can get chips by using a mechanitor to summon a Three Lords threat. They can also be summoned separately.
LanguageData.AdvancedMechtech.label: Advanced Mechtech
LanguageData.AdvancedMechtech.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control Advanced-tier mechanoids. You can get chips by using a mechanitor to summon a Gazer threat.
